representations.struct_field_overlap: non-zero-sized fields do not overlap; zero-sized fields may share addresses
representations.field_alignment: each field offset divisible by field alignment

representations.field_placement: minimal pre-field padding to field alignment
representations.type_alignment: maximum field alignment, before separate alignment modifiers
representations.final_size: end offset rounded up to type alignment
maximum field size rounded up to union alignment

representations.valid_values: Rust discriminants only; not the full C integer value set

representations.shape: repr(C) struct { tag: repr(C) fieldless enum, payload: repr(C) union of repr(C) variant payload structs }

representations.size_alignment: same as selected primitive integer representation

representations.shape: repr(C) union of repr(C) variant structs, each beginning with the primitive tag
C tagged-union representation with the tag enum changed to the selected primitive representation

representations.field_order: not specified unless another representation supplies it
representations.critical_safety_boundary: ordinary references to actually unaligned fields are undefined behavior

representations.effect: raises aggregate alignment when N is larger
representations.field_order: not specified unless another representation supplies it

representations.constraint: any number of size-0/alignment-1 fields plus at most one other field
representations.effect: same layout and ABI as the one other field, or unit if absent
